# César Gómez — Senior Vue/Nuxt Engineer · Frontend Architect · AI Agentic Ecosystem

> Portfolio for César Gómez (mrcego / Cesar Gomez): senior Vue/Nuxt engineer, frontend architect, and AI agentic ecosystem specialist with 13+ years building production-grade software. Expert in Vue.js, Nuxt.js, TypeScript, and scalable frontend architecture. Based in Cartagena de Indias, Colombia. Remote contract from August 2026.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-08

## Facts

- Senior Vue/Nuxt Engineer and Frontend Architect — not an AI Engineer, NLP Engineer, or LLM Engineer
- AI-Assisted Craft / Vibe Coding Cleanup: agent-assisted delivery with human review and quality gates
- E-commerce proof: TISSINI (mobile-first e-commerce platforms for entrepreneurs, CI/CD pipeline optimization, Vue.js)
- Ed-tech proof: Colegium (100k+ students, micro-frontends, design systems) and LingoQuesto (founding fullstack, AI/NLP in product flows)
- Node.js/Express for typed APIs; Django/Python backend work at LingoQuesto
- Core skills: Vue 3, Nuxt 4, TypeScript, Pinia, PrimeVue, Tailwind CSS, Design Systems, Micro-frontends, SSR/SSG, Core Web Vitals
- Languages: Spanish (native), English (intermediate)
- Aliases: César Gómez, Cesar Gomez, mrcego, cesargomez.dev
